# Public content regression fixture

Captured on 2026-11-10 by dot from:
- https://sixiangjialaundry.com/social-posts.json
- https://sixiangjialaundry.com/sitemap.xml

`public-index.json` retains the public feed metadata and only the 30 article records whose canonical URLs appeared in the captured sitemap. Both `posts` and `article_posts` are deliberately limited to this cohort for deterministic rendering. The public sitemap also had a posts listing URL. Sitemap inclusion is not a claim of Google indexing.

No customer records, credentials, or private source calendars are included. The fixture is not a production publication input and does not authorize publishing future posts.
